raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stacked on #46949 (customized_info through the Rust frontend): this PR's own change is its last commit, and its base moves to `main` once that one lands.

## Motivation

In Rust frontend mode, native `/generate` frames carried only the `cached_tokens` total: `meta_info.cached_tokens_details` was missing (#46205 left it out), and `sglang:cached_tokens_total` counted every cached token as `cache_source="device"`. With a hierarchical cache or a storage backend attached, a client could not tell a host or storage hit from a device hit, and a test that reads HiCache or storage hit counts from `meta_info` sees zero host and storage hits even though the cache works. Python's server reports the breakdown on every frame.

## Modifications

Each request's cached tokens per tier travel from the scheduler to the Rust frontend:

- **Scheduler side:** when the cache has a host or storage tier (HiCache, LMCache), or on a PD decode server (which takes the split from prefill), the scheduler sends each row's `(device, host, storage)` counts as a new optional `BatchHeader` column, plus the attached storage backend's type once per frame. A device-only cache sends nothing, and the frontend reports every cached token on device.
- **Frontend side:** the frontend renders `meta_info.cached_tokens_details` with Python's shape and presence rule:
  - present on every frame, `null` without cached tokens;
  - `{device, host}`, plus `storage` when it is nonzero or a storage tier is attached, plus `storage_backend` while one is attached.
- **Metric:** `sglang:cached_tokens_total` is split by `cache_source`, and a source's series is registered at its first hit, as in Python.
- **Hot path:** a device-only cache adds no per-row work. Where the split is sent, it costs one tuple per row on the scheduler thread. The details ride in the boxed `ChunkExtras`, so `ChunkEvent` keeps its size.
- **API:** `api.v1` gains `CachedTokensDetails` and `GenerateMetaInfo.cached_tokens_details` (field 21), regenerated with `cargo gen-api`. Every Rust `/generate` frame now carries the key, as Python's does.
- **Scope:** abort frames keep the details the stream reported; Python reports none for them. The OpenAI-compatible endpoints are unchanged.

A fixture built by Python (`rust/sglang-server/testdata/frame_metadata.json`) pins both sides: the headers `push_generation` sends, the details the scheduler's `get_cached_tokens_details` derives, and the `cached_tokens_total` increments the Python metrics collector records. It covers miss, device, host, storage, unsplit and short-split rows, with and without a storage tier; `frame_metadata_matches_python` and `cached_tokens_split_by_source_matches_python` decode it on the Rust side, and `test_frame_metadata_fixture_matches_python` fails if Python drifts from it. Weakening the `storage` presence rule fails the fixture test.

## Adaptation beyond the change

One test-only commit sits on top of the port and is not part of the original change: after #47166, `SchedulerOutputStreamer.__post_init__` also reads `get_observability().enable_metrics`, so the two tests in this PR that build a streamer by hand now stub `get_observability` with both `enable_metrics` and `enable_request_time_stats_logging` (`TestOutputStreamerCachedTokensSplit` had stubbed only the latter; `build_rust_frame_metadata_fixture` in `test_rust_server_extension.py` had no stub at all). No runtime code changes.

After #47178, which split `_GenerationStreamAccumulator.accept` into an `if self.rust_server_mode:` branch and an `else:` branch, the per-row `cached_tokens_split` append that this PR had attached as an `elif` to the old `if not self.rust_server_mode:` now sits inside the new `if self.rust_server_mode:` block as a plain `if self.cached_tokens_split is not None:`. Same eight lines, re-indented; no other change.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model forward or kernel code changes. Generation output is unchanged; only `meta_info` gains a key.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run. A device-only cache sends nothing new; where a host or storage tier exists the split costs one tuple per row on the scheduler thread, and the frame's `ChunkEvent` does not grow.

## Testing

- `rust/`: `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy -p sglang-server -p sglang-api-types --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean; `cargo test -p sglang-server -p sglang-api-types` passes (401 + 20 + 1); `cargo gen-api` produces no drift.
- Python (`python -m unittest`): `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_json_contract.py`, `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_parity.py`, `test/registered/unit/managers/test_output_streamer_customized_info.py`, `test/registered/unit/multimodal/rust/shared/test_rust_server_extension.py`: 60 tests pass.
- The change was also checked against a real server with a small public model, Python and Rust frontends side by side, re-sending a long prompt after enough distinct prompts to evict it: with a device-only cache both report the hit on `device`; with `--enable-hierarchical-cache` both report it on `host` and register the `host` metric series; with `--hicache-storage-backend file` both report `storage` and `storage_backend: "HiCacheFile"`, the storage count differing only with prefetch timing. Not rerun for this PR: PD and LMCache servers (the PD-decode gate is covered by a unit test).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -377,6 +377,7 @@ class GenerateMetaInfo(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True, frozen=True):
     image_tokens: Optional[int] = None
     audio_tokens: Optional[int] = None
     video_tokens: Optional[int] = None
+    cached_tokens_details: Optional[CachedTokensDetails] = None
 
     @classmethod
     def from_json_value(cls, value: Any) -> "GenerateMetaInfo":
@@ -405,6 +406,24 @@ def to_json_value(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
         return encode_WeightVersionSpan(self)
 
 
+class CachedTokensDetails(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True, frozen=True):
+    """sglang.api.v1.CachedTokensDetails: JSON object (unknown keys ignored)."""
+
+    device: int = 0
+    host: int = 0
+    storage: Optional[int] = None
+    storage_backend: Optional[str] = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json_value(cls, value: Any) -> "CachedTokensDetails":
+        """Decode a parsed JSON value; raises JsonContractError on a contract violation."""
+        return decode_CachedTokensDetails(value)
+
+    def to_json_value(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """Encode to a JSON-ready value (json.dumps-compatible)."""
+        return encode_CachedTokensDetails(self)
+
+
 class GenerateResponse(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True, frozen=True):
     """sglang.api.v1.GenerateResponse: JSON object (unknown keys ignored)."""
 
@@ -1785,6 +1804,8 @@ def decode_GenerateMetaInfo(value: Any) -> GenerateMetaInfo:
             kw["audio_tokens"] = None if x is None else _expect_uint(x, expected="u32")
         elif key == "video_tokens":
             kw["video_tokens"] = None if x is None else _expect_uint(x, expected="u32")
+        elif key == "cached_tokens_details":
+            kw["cached_tokens_details"] = None if x is None else decode_CachedTokensDetails(x)
     return GenerateMetaInfo(**kw)
 
 
@@ -1824,6 +1845,7 @@ def encode_GenerateMetaInfo(v: GenerateMetaInfo) -> Dict[str, Any]:
         d["audio_tokens"] = v.audio_tokens
     if v.video_tokens is not None:
         d["video_tokens"] = v.video_tokens
+    d["cached_tokens_details"] = None if v.cached_tokens_details is None else encode_CachedTokensDetails(v.cached_tokens_details)
     return d
 
 
@@ -1848,6 +1870,32 @@ def encode_WeightVersionSpan(v: WeightVersionSpan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
     return d
 
 
+def decode_CachedTokensDetails(value: Any) -> CachedTokensDetails:
+    m = _expect_map(value, expected="struct CachedTokensDetails")
+    kw: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for key, x in m.items():
+        if key == "device":
+            kw["device"] = _expect_uint(x, expected="u32")
+        elif key == "host":
+            kw["host"] = _expect_uint(x, expected="u32")
+        elif key == "storage":
+            kw["storage"] = None if x is None else _expect_uint(x, expected="u32")
+        elif key == "storage_backend":
+            kw["storage_backend"] = None if x is None else _expect_str(x, expected="a string")
+    return CachedTokensDetails(**kw)
+
+
+def encode_CachedTokensDetails(v: CachedTokensDetails) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    d: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    d["device"] = v.device
+    d["host"] = v.host
+    if v.storage is not None:
+        d["storage"] = v.storage
+    if v.storage_backend is not None:
+        d["storage_backend"] = v.storage_backend
+    return d
+
+
 def decode_GenerateResponse(value: Any) -> GenerateResponse:
     m = _expect_map(value, expected="struct GenerateResponse")
     kw: Dict[str, Any] = {}

@@ -104,6 +104,19 @@ def _get_storage_backend_type(self) -> str:
             storage_backend_type = "LMCache"
         return storage_backend_type
 
+    def _rust_frames_split_cached_tokens(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether Rust egress frames carry each request's cached tokens by
+        tier, from which the frontend reports what
+        ``get_cached_tokens_details`` would. Only a cache with a host or
+        storage tier, or a PD decode server (which takes the split from
+        prefill), serves hits from anywhere but the device; otherwise the
+        frontend reports every cached token on device."""
+        return self.rust_server is not None and (
+            self.server_args.enable_hierarchical_cache
+            or self.server_args.enable_lmcache
+            or self.disaggregation_mode == DisaggregationMode.DECODE
